title: Almost free algebras: from the word problem to elimination of quantifiers
summary: Term algebras are important objects in computer science and are correspondingly well-studied. A natural generalization is to quotient these algebras by finitely many ground term equations, obtaining what we call almost free algebras. One of the earliest results on almost free algebras is that their word problem is polynomial time decidable.
